scope: generic 53BK reference behavior applied to the observed 2021-12-25 qlsn A1 mobile Pagepic
guardrails: Generic CMS behavior is evidence for filename construction, not proof that a historical qlsn asset survived in an archive.
A historical PC image or Pagepdf is promoted only after an actual media response or an archived page explicitly references it.
Do not treat a mobile filename with the prefix removed as the PC filename; the CMS uses the pc prefix.
Do not infer Pagepdf by replacing a Pagepic extension because Pagepdf can be independently uploaded and arbitrarily named.
